title: Save a Claude asset by file or URL, its manifest and refs checked, as immutable versions in the object store

tasks.title: Save a Claude asset with its manifest and refs checked, versions, dry run, daily limit, reads and deletion
Import a Claude asset from a public HTTPS URL, pinned to the checked address, no redirects

acs.text: WHEN a signed-in user posts `{html}` to `POST /api/v1/claude-assets` with one valid manifest THE SYSTEM SHALL ask Sefaria to check and expand every declared ref, keep the file in the object store under `assets/<assetId>/<sha256>.html`, create the asset and its version 1 with the normalized manifest (each ref with its normal form, Hebrew form, section refs and segment refs), and answer 201 with the asset and the version; the title and description come from the manifest, never from the caller
scenarios: AC-001 a valid file becomes an asset with version 1

acs.text: WHEN the body carries the `assetId` of one of the caller's assets THE SYSTEM SHALL add the next version (n + 1) and make it current; an `assetId` that is unknown or belongs to someone else SHALL be 404 and nothing stored; posting the same bytes as the asset's current version (or, without `assetId`, as the current version of one of the caller's assets) SHALL answer 200 with that version and store nothing new
scenarios: AC-002 new versions belong to the owner, and the same bytes are not stored twice

acs.text: WHEN the file is larger than `ASSET_MAX_BYTES` (5 MB by default), has no `<script type="application/json"
scenarios: AC-003 a file that cannot be saved is refused with problems a model can act on

acs.text: WHEN the body has `dryRun: true` THE SYSTEM SHALL run every check and answer 200 with the normalized manifest, the size and the hash, store nothing, and not count it toward the daily limit
scenarios: AC-004 a dry run checks without storing or counting

acs.text: WHEN a user has already saved `ASSET_DAILY_LIMIT` (20 by default) new versions in the last 24 hours THE SYSTEM SHALL refuse the next save with 429 `asset.daily_limit` and store nothing
WHEN Sefaria cannot be asked (no answer within 10 seconds, an error status, or an answer that does not match its schema) THE SYSTEM SHALL answer 503 `asset.refs_unavailable` and store nothing

WHEN a signed-in user posts `{url}` to `POST /api/v1/claude-assets/import` THE SYSTEM SHALL fetch it once and save it by the path of AC-001 to AC-006, keeping the URL as `sourceUrl` (shown, never fetched again, never embedded); it SHALL refuse with 422 and a problem code, before or instead of fetching: a URL that is not `https`; a `claude.ai` or `claudeusercontent.com` URL (or a subdomain), with a message that names the two working routes (the Sefaria connector in Claude, "save this to Sefaria", and downloading the file and uploading it); a host that resolves to a private, loopback, link-local, unique-local, carrier-grade NAT or cloud metadata address; any redirect; an answer that is not `text/html`; and a body that passes the size limit while it is read
scenarios: AC-007 import from a URL, with its refusals

acs.text: WHEN anyone asks for `GET /api/v1/claude-assets/{assetId}` THE SYSTEM SHALL answer with the asset's title, description, author (name, profile id, whether verified), source URL, current and published version ids, its versions and the current manifest, and no Sefaria user id; a hidden or unknown asset SHALL be 404; `GET /api/v1/claude-assets` SHALL list the caller's own assets, hidden ones included and marked
scenarios: AC-008 reading an asset, and listing one's own

acs.text: WHEN the owner deletes an asset with `DELETE /api/v1/claude-assets/{assetId}`, or the owner's account is deleted, THE SYSTEM SHALL remove the asset, its versions and every file under `assets/<assetId>/`; anyone else SHALL get 404
scenarios: AC-009 deleting an asset, or its owner
